Binomial expansion of product coagulation, retaining the two endpoint terms, gives dM_p/dt=(pM2(t)-λ)M_p+λ+(1/2)∑_{j=2}^{p-2}C(p,j)M_{j+1}M_{p-j+1}. Finite-time truncation/induction and Grönwall justify each order. For λ>p²/(p-1), algebra gives c=λ-p aλ>0, and all lower moments are bounded by induction, so M_p is bounded and converges to its explicit stationary recurrence. For 4<λ≤p²/(p-1), if stationary M_p were finite, all lower moments would be finite, allowing a stationary balance with LHS (λ-paλ)M_p≤0 and strictly positive RHS λ+..., a contradiction, including equality. Independent exact root comparisons p=3,4,5,8 verify the threshold algebra. No finite cutoff used to infer divergence.
